title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon
summary: Tender chicken braised with olives, preserved lemon and saffron in a fragrant onion sauce.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Season chicken with salt, ginger and turmeric; finely slice onions and mince garlic.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Brown chicken skin-side down in olive oil for 6 minutes, turn and lift onto a plate; soften onions in the same pot.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Add garlic, saffron and stock; return chicken, cover and simmer gently for 35 minutes until cooked through.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Add rinsed preserved lemon strips and olives for the last 10 minutes; reduce uncovered until glossy and serve with couscous.

tips: Rinse preserved lemon to control saltiness.
variations: Add chopped coriander and parsley at the end.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Sichuan Mapo Tofu
summary: Silken tofu and minced pork simmered in a fiery, numbing chilli-bean sauce with Sichuan pepper.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Cut tofu into cubes and briefly blanch in salted simmering water; drain carefully to keep pieces intact.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Brown pork in a hot wok, then fry minced ginger, garlic, doubanjiang and black beans until the oil turns red.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Add stock and tofu; simmer gently 6–8 minutes without vigorous stirring so the tofu absorbs the sauce.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stir cornflour with 2 tbsp cold water and add gradually to thicken; finish with crushed toasted peppercorns and spring onion.

tips: Use a gentle folding motion to keep the tofu whole.
variations: Use finely chopped mushrooms instead of pork.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken
summary: Smoky grilled chicken with allspice, thyme, spring onion and Scotch bonnet heat, brightened with lime.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Blend spring onions, garlic, chilli, allspice, thyme, soy, lime, sugar and oil into a rough marinade.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Score the chicken, rub marinade under the skin and refrigerate for at least 4 hours in a covered dish.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Grill over medium indirect heat, turning regularly for 35–45 minutes, until the thickest meat reaches 75°C.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Move briefly over direct heat to char the skin without burning the sugar; rest 5 minutes and serve with lime.

tips: Wear gloves when handling Scotch bonnet and start with half for milder heat.
variations: Roast at 200°C if you do not have a grill.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Turkish İmam Bayıldı
summary: Soft roasted aubergines filled with sweet onions, tomatoes and garlic, finished with fruity olive oil.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Halve aubergines lengthways, score flesh, brush with oil and roast cut-side up at 200°C for 25 minutes.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Slowly soften sliced onions in olive oil; add garlic, diced tomatoes and sugar and cook until jammy.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Press a hollow into each softened aubergine and spoon in tomato-onion filling; drizzle with remaining oil.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cover and bake 20 minutes more until collapsing tender; cool slightly and finish with lemon and parsley.

tips: This dish is excellent warm or at room temperature.
variations: Add toasted pine nuts to the filling.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: French Chicken Chasseur
summary: Golden chicken braised with mushrooms, shallots, white wine and tomatoes in a glossy herb sauce.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Pat chicken dry, season and brown in butter and oil for 5 minutes per side; set aside.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Sauté sliced mushrooms until moisture evaporates, then add shallots and garlic and soften for 3 minutes.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Stir in tomato paste, pour in wine and reduce by half; add stock and tomatoes and return chicken.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cover and simmer 25–30 minutes until chicken reaches 75°C; uncover to reduce and finish with tarragon.

tips: Brown mushrooms well before adding liquid for deeper flavour.
variations: Use parsley instead of tarragon.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Mexican Pozole Rojo
summary: Hearty pork and hominy soup in a deep red guajillo chilli broth with crunchy fresh toppings.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Remove chilli stems and seeds, toast briefly in a dry pan and soak in hot water for 15 minutes.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Simmer pork with half the onion, stock and salt for 75–90 minutes until tender; skim foam as needed.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Blend softened chillies with garlic, remaining onion and a ladle of stock; strain into pork and add drained hominy.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Simmer 20 minutes more, shred pork into bite-sized pieces and serve with cabbage, radish, oregano and lime.

tips: Straining the chilli purée makes the broth smoother.
variations: Use chicken thighs for a quicker version.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Greek Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
summary: Roasted chicken and potatoes soaked in lemon, oregano and garlic, with crisp edges and savoury pan juices.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Cut potatoes into thick wedges and arrange around seasoned chicken in a large roasting dish.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, crushed garlic, oregano, paprika and stock; pour evenly over the dish.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Roast at 200°C for 45 minutes, turning potatoes once and basting chicken with pan juices.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cook until chicken reaches 75°C and potatoes are tender; increase heat briefly for golden edges and rest 5 minutes.

tips: Use a wide dish so potatoes roast rather than steam.
variations: Add artichoke hearts for the last 20 minutes.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Japanese Miso-Glazed Aubergine
summary: Tender roasted aubergine lacquered with sweet-salty miso glaze and finished with toasted sesame.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Halve aubergines lengthways and score the flesh in a diamond pattern without cutting through the skin.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Brush with oil and roast cut-side up at 210°C for 20–25 minutes until soft and lightly browned.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Whisk miso, mirin, sugar and soy sauce; spread a thin layer over the hot aubergine flesh.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Grill for 2–3 minutes until bubbling and caramelised, watching closely; top with spring onions and sesame.

tips: Miso glaze burns quickly, so apply it near the end.
variations: Use red miso for a stronger, saltier finish.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Spanish Albóndigas in Tomato Sauce
summary: Juicy pork-and-beef meatballs simmered in smoky tomato sauce with paprika and garlic.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Mix mince, egg, breadcrumbs, half the garlic and salt gently; roll into walnut-sized balls without compacting.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Brown meatballs in olive oil in batches, turning carefully; transfer to a plate before fully cooked.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Soften diced onion and remaining garlic, add paprika and passata and simmer for 10 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Return meatballs and simmer 12–15 minutes until cooked through to 75°C; finish with parsley and crusty bread.

tips: Overmixing the mince makes meatballs tough.
variations: Add a pinch of chilli flakes to the sauce.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Vietnamese Caramelised Pork Bowls
summary: Sticky minced pork cooked with fish sauce, caramel and garlic, served over rice with crisp cucumber.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Rinse jasmine rice and cook with measured water; keep covered while preparing the pork.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Heat sugar with 1 tbsp water in a small pan until amber, then carefully add 3 tbsp warm water to loosen.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Brown pork in a hot wok, add minced shallot and garlic, then stir in caramel and fish sauce.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cook until glossy and reduced, taste for sweet-salty balance and spoon over rice with cucumber and lime.

tips: Stand back when adding water to hot caramel because it may splutter.
variations: Add chopped lemongrass with the garlic.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Tunisian Harissa Baked Fish
summary: Flaky white fish baked over peppers and tomatoes with smoky harissa, cumin and bright lemon.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Slice peppers and onion, toss with oil and cumin and roast at 200°C for 20 minutes.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Stir harissa with lemon juice and a spoonful of oil; pat fish dry and brush with the mixture.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Nestle fish among softened vegetables, scatter tomatoes around and return to oven for 12–15 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Check fish is opaque and flakes easily, then scatter parsley and serve with couscous.

tips: Harissa heat varies by brand; taste before coating fish.
variations: Use salmon fillets instead of white fish.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Polish Bigos Hunter's Stew
summary: Slow-cooked pork, sausage, sauerkraut and mushrooms in a tangy, deeply savoury cabbage stew.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Cube pork and brown in oil in batches; transfer to a plate and sauté onion and mushrooms.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Add sliced sausage, shredded cabbage, rinsed sauerkraut, caraway and bay leaves.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Return pork, pour in stock and simmer covered over low heat for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Uncover and cook another 20 minutes until pork is tender and the stew thickens; adjust acidity and salt.

tips: Taste sauerkraut before rinsing; some batches need their tang preserved.
variations: Add dried porcini and their strained soaking liquid.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Chinese Steamed Ginger Fish
summary: Delicate steamed fish with ginger, spring onions and a sizzling soy-sesame dressing.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Pat fish dry, lay on a heatproof plate and scatter half the julienned ginger and spring onions over it.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Place plate in a covered steamer over boiling water and steam 8–12 minutes, depending on thickness.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Check fish is opaque and flakes easily; carefully pour away excess steaming liquid.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Top with remaining ginger and spring onion, drizzle with soy and wine, then pour over hot oil and finish with sesame oil.

tips: Use a plate with a rim to catch the juices safely.
variations: Add sliced fresh chilli for heat.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: American Turkey Meatloaf
summary: Juicy turkey meatloaf with sautéed vegetables and a sticky tomato glaze, sliced thick for dinner.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Soften finely diced onion, carrot and garlic in a little oil; cool so they do not warm the raw mince.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Mix turkey with egg, breadcrumbs, milk, vegetables and seasoning just until combined; shape into a loaf.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Whisk ketchup, Worcestershire and sugar; spread half over loaf and bake at 180°C for 35 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Add remaining glaze and bake until centre reaches 74°C; rest 10 minutes before slicing.

tips: Do not pack the loaf tightly or it can turn dense.
variations: Use chicken mince in place of turkey.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Turkish Mercimek Çorbası
summary: Velvety red lentil soup with carrot, cumin and lemon, finished with chilli butter.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Rinse lentils until the water runs mostly clear; dice onion, carrot and potato evenly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Soften onion in 1 tbsp butter, add carrot and potato, then stir in tomato paste and cumin.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Add lentils and stock; simmer 25 minutes until everything is soft, then blend until smooth.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Melt remaining butter with paprika, spoon over bowls and serve with lemon wedges.

tips: Add hot stock gradually when blending if you prefer a thinner soup.
variations: Add dried mint to the chilli butter.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Japanese Onigiri with Tuna Mayo
summary: Soft salted rice triangles stuffed with creamy tuna and wrapped in crisp nori.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Rinse rice several times until water is clearer, then cook covered and rest 10 minutes off heat.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Drain tuna thoroughly and mix with mayonnaise and soy sauce; taste before adding extra salt.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Wet and lightly salt your hands, flatten a scoop of warm rice and add a teaspoon of filling in the centre.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Enclose filling with more rice, shape gently into a triangle and wrap with nori immediately before eating.

tips: Use warm, not hot, rice so it holds together comfortably.
variations: Fill with flaked cooked salmon instead.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Mexican Tostadas de Frijoles
summary: Crunchy corn tortillas layered with creamy refried beans, shredded lettuce, salsa and crumbly cheese.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Brush tortillas lightly with oil and bake at 200°C for 8–10 minutes until crisp, turning once.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Soften diced onion and garlic, add beans with a splash of water and cumin, then mash to a spreadable consistency.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Chop lettuce and tomatoes, crumble cheese and slice avocado just before assembling.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Spread warm beans over each tortilla, add lettuce, tomato, avocado and cheese, then finish with lime.

tips: Assemble at the last moment so tostadas stay crisp.
variations: Top with shredded cooked chicken.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Vietnamese Rice Paper Rolls
summary: Fresh translucent rolls filled with prawns, rice noodles, lettuce and herbs, served with tangy dipping sauce.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Cook vermicelli, rinse under cool water and drain; cut vegetables into fine matchsticks.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Mix hoisin and peanut butter with warm water and lime juice to make a pourable dipping sauce.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Dip one rice paper sheet briefly in warm water, lay flat and arrange lettuce, noodles, vegetables, herbs and prawns.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Fold sides inward and roll tightly without tearing; repeat and serve promptly with sauce.

tips: Avoid over-soaking rice paper because it softens further on the board.
variations: Use tofu strips instead of prawns.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Swedish Overnight Oats with Berries
summary: Creamy chilled oats with yoghurt, cardamom, tart berries and toasted almonds for an easy make-ahead breakfast.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Stir oats, milk, yoghurt, honey and cardamom together in a bowl until evenly mixed.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Divide between four jars, cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours to soften.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Toast almonds in a dry pan until fragrant, then cool and roughly chop.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stir oats before serving, loosen with milk if needed and top with berries and almonds.

tips: Add toppings just before eating to keep nuts crunchy.
variations: Use grated apple and cinnamon instead of berries.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Italian Ricotta Pancakes
summary: Light, tender pancakes enriched with ricotta and lemon zest, served with warm berries.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Whisk ricotta, egg yolks, milk, sugar and lemon zest until smooth; fold in flour and baking powder.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Beat egg whites to soft peaks and fold gently into batter without knocking out the air.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Cook small pancakes in a lightly buttered non-stick pan over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes per side.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Warm berries briefly in a saucepan until juicy and spoon over pancakes just before serving.

tips: Do not press the pancakes while cooking or they lose their airy texture.
variations: Swap lemon zest for orange zest.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Greek Yoghurt Honey Bowls
summary: Thick yoghurt topped with floral honey, toasted walnuts and juicy figs for a refreshing breakfast.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Toast walnuts in a dry pan over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes until fragrant; cool completely.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Wash figs, trim stems and cut into quarters; finely grate a little orange zest.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Spoon chilled yoghurt into bowls and arrange figs and walnuts on top.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Drizzle with honey, sprinkle cinnamon and orange zest, and serve immediately.

tips: Use thick strained yoghurt so the toppings stay suspended.
variations: Swap figs for berries or sliced peaches.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Spanish Pan con Tomate
summary: Toasted rustic bread rubbed with garlic and ripe tomato, finished with olive oil and flaky salt.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Toast sourdough on a grill or in a hot pan until crisp outside but still tender inside.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Halve garlic and rub the cut side lightly over the hot bread.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Halve ripe tomatoes and grate the flesh onto the toast, leaving skins behind.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Drizzle generously with olive oil, add flaky salt and serve while the toast is crisp.

tips: Very ripe tomatoes make the best juicy topping.
variations: Add thin slices of jamón or grated Manchego.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Japanese Sunomono Cucumber Salad
summary: Thin cucumber ribbons in a delicate sweet rice-vinegar dressing with toasted sesame seeds.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Slice cucumbers paper-thin, sprinkle with salt and rest for 10 minutes to soften.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Rinse quickly and squeeze gently to remove moisture without crushing the slices.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Stir rice vinegar, sugar and soy sauce until sugar dissolves completely.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Toss cucumber with dressing, chill briefly and sprinkle toasted sesame over the top.

tips: A mandoline gives evenly thin slices; use its hand guard.
variations: Add cooked wakame seaweed for a classic variation.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Italian Marinated Artichokes
summary: Tender artichoke hearts dressed with lemon, parsley, garlic and olive oil for a bright antipasto.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Drain artichoke hearts thoroughly and cut large pieces in half for even dressing.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Finely mince garlic and parsley, then whisk with lemon zest, juice, olive oil and oregano.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Toss artichokes gently in the dressing, coating all surfaces without breaking the hearts.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Refrigerate 30 minutes to meld flavours; bring close to room temperature before serving.

tips: Use artichokes packed in water for better control of the marinade.
variations: Add capers and chopped olives.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Chinese Garlic Green Beans
summary: Blistered green beans tossed with sizzling garlic and a savoury soy sauce glaze.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Trim beans and dry thoroughly with a clean towel so they blister rather than steam.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Heat oil in a wide wok until shimmering and stir-fry beans in batches until wrinkled and tender-crisp.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Reduce heat, add minced garlic and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant but not brown.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Add soy and sugar, toss until lightly glazed and finish with sesame oil.

tips: Keep beans moving in the hot wok to prevent scorching.
variations: Add chilli crisp for a spicy finish.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Greek Tzatziki
summary: Thick yoghurt dip with grated cucumber, garlic, dill and lemon, perfect beside grilled meats.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Grate cucumber and squeeze it firmly in a clean cloth to remove excess moisture.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Crush garlic with a pinch of salt into a paste to distribute its flavour evenly.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Fold cucumber, garlic, chopped dill and lemon juice into thick yoghurt.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Chill at least 20 minutes, drizzle with olive oil and serve cold.

tips: Start with one garlic clove if you prefer a gentler flavour.
variations: Add fresh mint alongside dill.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: French Pear Tarte Tatin
summary: Caramelised pears baked beneath buttery puff pastry and turned out into a glossy upside-down tart.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Peel and halve pears, remove cores and toss with a little lemon juice to prevent browning.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Melt sugar in an ovenproof skillet until amber, then swirl in butter carefully and arrange pears cut-side up.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Cook pears in caramel for 8 minutes, drape pastry over and tuck edges down around the fruit.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes until puffed and golden; rest 5 minutes before carefully inverting.

tips: Use firm pears so they keep their shape in the caramel.
variations: Add a pinch of cardamom to the caramel.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Indian Kheer Rice Pudding
summary: Creamy slow-simmered rice pudding scented with cardamom, saffron and toasted pistachios.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Rinse rice, soak for 15 minutes and drain; crush cardamom pods lightly to release aroma.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Bring milk to a gentle simmer in a heavy saucepan and add rice, cardamom and saffron.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Cook over low heat 40–50 minutes, stirring often, until rice is soft and milk thickened; add sugar near the end.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Remove cardamom pods, stir in rosewater and top with chopped pistachios; serve warm or chilled.

tips: Scrape the bottom of the pan regularly to prevent milk catching.
variations: Use almonds instead of pistachios.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Turkish Sütlaç Rice Pudding
summary: Silky baked rice pudding with a lightly caramelised top and delicate vanilla flavour.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Simmer rice in water until very soft and most liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Add milk and sugar, simmer gently for 15 minutes, then stir in cornflour mixed with cold milk.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Cook 3 minutes until lightly thickened, add vanilla and divide among ovenproof ramekins.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Place ramekins in a shallow water bath and grill tops until mottled golden; cool and refrigerate before serving.

tips: Watch closely under the grill because the surface browns quickly.
variations: Sprinkle cinnamon over the chilled pudding.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: American Peach Cobbler
summary: Juicy cinnamon peaches baked beneath a golden, tender biscuit topping and served warm.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Slice peaches and toss with half the sugar, lemon juice and cinnamon in a baking dish.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Mix flour, baking powder and remaining sugar, then rub in cold butter until crumbly.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Stir in milk just until a soft dough forms and drop spoonfuls over the fruit, leaving gaps for steam.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake at 190°C for 35–40 minutes until topping is golden and peach juices bubble; rest 10 minutes.

tips: Use ripe but firm peaches so the filling does not turn mushy.
variations: Swap peaches for nectarines or plums.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: French Clafoutis with Cherries
summary: Juicy cherries baked in a delicate vanilla custard batter with lightly crisp edges.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Butter a shallow baking dish and scatter pitted cherries evenly over the base.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Whisk eggs and sugar until combined, then whisk in flour, milk, melted butter and vanilla until smooth.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Pour batter carefully around cherries and bake at 180°C for 35–40 minutes until puffed and just set.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Rest 10 minutes as custard settles, then dust lightly with icing sugar and serve warm.

tips: Avoid overbaking; the centre should retain a gentle wobble.
variations: Use sliced apricots when cherries are out of season.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Mexican Churros with Chocolate Sauce
summary: Crisp cinnamon-sugar churros with soft centres, dipped into warm dark chocolate sauce.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Bring water and butter to a boil, add flour at once and stir vigorously until dough pulls from pan; cool 5 minutes.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Beat eggs into warm dough one at a time, then pipe short ridged lengths onto baking paper.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Fry batches in oil at 175°C until deeply golden and cooked through; drain and toss in cinnamon sugar.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Heat cream until steaming, pour over chopped chocolate and stir smooth; serve with hot churros.

tips: Use a thermometer to keep oil at a steady 175°C.
variations: Add orange zest to the chocolate sauce.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Greek Portokalopita
summary: Syrup-soaked orange and yoghurt cake made with crisp filo pieces and fragrant citrus zest.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Tear filo into small pieces and dry in a low oven at 100°C until crisp, then cool.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Whisk eggs, yoghurt, olive oil, orange zest and baking powder; fold in dried filo evenly.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Pour into a greased baking dish and bake at 180°C for 35–40 minutes until golden and set.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Simmer water, sugar and orange juice into a light syrup; pour cooled syrup over hot cake and rest to absorb.

tips: Dry filo thoroughly so it absorbs batter without clumping.
variations: Add a cinnamon stick to the syrup.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Australian Anzac Biscuits
summary: Golden oat-and-coconut biscuits with crisp edges, chewy centres and rich golden syrup flavour.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Combine oats, flour, coconut and brown sugar in a large bowl and preheat oven to 170°C.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Melt butter with golden syrup over low heat, then dissolve bicarbonate in boiling water and stir into butter mixture.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Pour foaming mixture into dry ingredients and mix until evenly moistened; roll into walnut-sized balls.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Space balls on lined trays, flatten slightly and bake 12–15 minutes until golden; cool on trays to firm.

tips: Bake a little longer for crisp biscuits or less for chewy centres.
variations: Add finely grated orange zest.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: American Banana Cream Pie
summary: Buttery biscuit crust filled with sliced bananas and vanilla custard, crowned with whipped cream.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Crush biscuits, mix with melted butter and press into a pie tin; chill until firm.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Whisk egg yolks, sugar and cornflour; slowly whisk in hot milk, then return to heat and stir until thick.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Cool custard slightly, layer sliced bananas in crust and pour custard over; chill at least 4 hours.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Whip cream to soft peaks, spread over set pie and garnish with fresh banana just before serving.

tips: Press cling film directly onto custard to prevent a skin.
variations: Add toasted coconut over the whipped cream.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Peruvian Aji de Gallina
summary: Shredded chicken in a creamy yellow chilli and walnut sauce, served with rice and olives.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Poach chicken gently in stock until it reaches 75°C, then shred and reserve broth.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Soak bread in evaporated milk; blend with walnuts and chilli paste until smooth.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Soften onion in oil, add blended sauce and enough reserved broth to make a thick simmering sauce.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Fold in chicken and warm through; serve over cooked rice with boiled egg and olives if available.

tips: Add aji amarillo gradually because brands vary in heat.
variations: Replace walnuts with pecans.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Thai Larb Gai
summary: Warm minced chicken salad with lime, fish sauce, mint and toasted rice powder.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Toast uncooked rice in a dry skillet until golden, cool and grind into a coarse powder.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Cook chicken mince with a splash of water over medium heat until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Remove from heat, toss with lime juice, fish sauce, finely sliced shallots and chilli.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Fold in mint, coriander and toasted rice powder; spoon into crisp lettuce leaves.

tips: Add herbs off the heat to keep them fresh.
variations: Use pork mince for larb moo.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Italian Ribollita
summary: Rustic Tuscan bean-and-vegetable soup thickened with bread, kale and olive oil.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Soften finely diced onion, carrot and celery in olive oil for 10 minutes.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Add tomatoes and stock, then simmer 15 minutes until vegetables soften.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Mash half the beans and add with remaining beans and chopped kale; simmer 10 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stir in torn stale bread and rest 10 minutes to thicken; drizzle with olive oil before serving.

tips: Use day-old bread so it absorbs broth without dissolving instantly.
variations: Add a Parmesan rind while simmering.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Indian Baingan Bharta
summary: Smoky mashed aubergine cooked with onion, tomato, ginger and green chilli.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Char aubergines over a gas flame or roast at 230°C until skin blackens and flesh collapses.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Cool, peel and mash the soft flesh, discarding tough skin and excess liquid.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Sizzle cumin seeds in oil, soften onion, then cook garlic, ginger, chilli and tomatoes until thick.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Add turmeric and aubergine, cook 8 minutes while stirring and finish with coriander.

tips: Blackened aubergine skin contributes the characteristic smoky flavour.
variations: Stir in peas for extra sweetness.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: German Kartoffelsalat
summary: Warm potato salad dressed with tangy mustard, vinegar and bacon instead of mayonnaise.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Boil whole potatoes in salted water until just tender, drain and peel while warm.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Cook diced bacon until crisp, then soften chopped onion in the rendered fat.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Whisk warm stock, vinegar and mustard into the pan and season generously.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Slice warm potatoes, pour over dressing and fold gently; rest 15 minutes and finish with parsley.

tips: Waxy potatoes hold their shape when tossed warm.
variations: Leave out bacon and add extra olive oil.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Chinese Tomato Egg Stir-Fry
summary: Soft scrambled eggs folded into juicy sweet-savoury tomatoes for a quick homestyle meal.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Beat eggs with a pinch of salt; cut tomatoes into wedges and slice spring onions.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Heat half the oil in a wok and scramble eggs gently until just set; transfer to a plate.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Add remaining oil and tomatoes, cook until juicy, then add sugar and soy sauce.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Return eggs, fold through tomatoes and thicken lightly with cornflour slurry if needed; serve with rice.

tips: Remove eggs while still soft because they cook again in the sauce.
variations: Add a dash of sesame oil before serving.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Egyptian Ful Medames
summary: Warm mashed fava beans with cumin, lemon, garlic and olive oil, scooped up with flatbread.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Drain and rinse fava beans, then simmer gently in a saucepan with 150 ml water for 10 minutes.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Mash some beans with a fork while leaving others whole for texture.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Stir in crushed garlic, cumin, lemon juice and salt, then warm through without drying out.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Spoon into bowls and top with olive oil, chopped tomatoes and parsley; serve with flatbread.

tips: Add warm water gradually to keep the beans creamy.
variations: Top with a chopped boiled egg.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Japanese Chicken Soboro Don
summary: Sweet-savoury minced chicken and fluffy scrambled egg served in colourful stripes over rice.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Rinse rice and cook covered according to packet directions; rest off heat before fluffing.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Cook chicken mince with soy, mirin, sugar and grated ginger, stirring until fine and fully cooked.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Beat eggs with a pinch of salt and scramble over low heat into small, soft curds.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Divide rice among bowls and arrange chicken and eggs side by side; finish with spring onions.

tips: Stir the chicken frequently for a fine, even mince texture.
variations: Add blanched green beans as a third topping.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Italian Polenta with Mushrooms
summary: Creamy Parmesan polenta topped with golden sautéed mushrooms, garlic and thyme.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Bring stock to a simmer and whisk in polenta gradually to avoid lumps.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Cook according to packet instructions, stirring frequently until thick and creamy.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Sear sliced mushrooms in hot olive oil until golden, then add garlic and thyme for the final minute.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stir butter and Parmesan into polenta, loosen with hot water if needed and spoon mushrooms over top.

tips: Avoid overcrowding mushrooms so they brown rather than steam.
variations: Finish with a little truffle oil.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: French Madeleines
summary: Delicate shell-shaped sponge cakes with buttery edges, lemon zest and a soft centre.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Whisk eggs and sugar until pale and slightly thickened; fold in flour and baking powder.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Stir in cooled melted butter, lemon zest and vanilla, then chill batter for 45 minutes.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Butter and flour a madeleine tin, then spoon batter into shell moulds without spreading.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake at 200°C for 9–11 minutes until risen and golden at edges; unmould and cool briefly.

tips: Chilled batter helps create the characteristic hump.
variations: Dip cooled madeleines in melted dark chocolate.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Greek Gemista Stuffed Tomatoes
summary: Oven-baked tomatoes and peppers filled with herbed rice, pine nuts and sweet onions.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Slice tops from tomatoes and peppers, scoop out centres and reserve tomato pulp; arrange shells in a baking dish.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Soften chopped onion and garlic in olive oil, add rice, tomato pulp, herbs and pine nuts.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Fill vegetables loosely to allow rice to expand, replace tops and pour stock around them.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cover and bake at 190°C for 45 minutes, then uncover 15 minutes until rice is tender and tops browned.

tips: Do not overfill shells because the rice expands as it cooks.
variations: Add raisins for a sweet-savoury variation.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: Brazilian Pão de Queijo
summary: Warm, chewy cheese breads with crisp shells made from tapioca starch and Parmesan.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Heat milk, oil and salt until steaming, then pour over tapioca starch and stir into a sticky dough.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Cool 5 minutes so eggs do not scramble, then beat in eggs one at a time.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Fold in finely grated Parmesan and roll mixture into small balls with lightly oiled hands.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until puffed and golden; serve while warm.

tips: Tapioca starch gives the signature stretchy texture.
variations: Use half mozzarella and half Parmesan.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.

title: French Leek and Potato Soup
summary: Smooth, buttery leek and potato soup finished with cream and fresh chives.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Split and rinse leeks thoroughly to remove grit, then slice white and pale-green parts.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Melt butter and soften leeks over low heat for 10 minutes without browning.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Add diced potatoes and stock, simmer 20 minutes until tender, then blend until smooth.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stir in cream and nutmeg, heat gently and serve with chopped chives.

tips: Avoid browning leeks to preserve the delicate flavour.
variations: Chill the soup for a vichyssoise-style version.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Mexican Sopa de Fideo
summary: Toasted vermicelli noodles simmered in a light tomato and garlic broth with lime.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Blend tomatoes with onion, garlic and a ladle of stock until smooth.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Break vermicelli into short lengths and toast in oil until evenly golden, stirring constantly.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Carefully add blended tomato mixture and simmer 5 minutes to soften its raw flavour.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Pour in remaining stock and cook until noodles are tender; finish with lime and coriander.

tips: Keep stirring noodles while toasting because they colour quickly.
variations: Add shredded cooked chicken for a heartier soup.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days; serve cold or reheat as appropriate.

title: Italian Caprese Stuffed Peppers
summary: Sweet roasted peppers filled with mozzarella, cherry tomatoes and basil, finished with balsamic glaze.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Halve peppers lengthways and remove seeds while keeping the stems intact for structure.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Brush with olive oil and roast at 200°C for 20 minutes until beginning to soften.

stages.title: Cook until ready
steps: Toss halved tomatoes with chopped garlic and basil, then spoon into peppers and add mozzarella.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Return to oven for 10 minutes until cheese melts and peppers are tender; drizzle balsamic glaze to serve.

tips: Drain mozzarella well to prevent watery filling.
variations: Add cooked quinoa beneath the tomato filling.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly in an airtight container for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dish.
